definitions.gloss: urgent task; pressing matter; top priority
definitions.explanation: Something that needs to be addressed immediately. A formal word commonly used in news, politics, and business to describe issues requiring immediate action.

examples.japanese: {人材|じんざい}{確保|かくほ}が{急務|きゅうむ}だ。
examples.english: Securing personnel is an urgent task.

examples.japanese: {老朽化|ろうきゅうか}したインフラの{整備|せいび}が{急務|きゅうむ}である。
examples.english: Maintenance of aging infrastructure is a pressing matter.

examples.japanese: {少子化|しょうしか}{対策|たいさく}は{国|くに}にとって{最|もっと}も{急務|きゅうむ}な{課題|かだい}の{一|ひと}つである。
examples.english: Measures against the declining birthrate are one of the most pressing issues for the country.

notes:
A formal noun meaning an urgent task or matter requiring immediate attention. Very commonly used in news reports, government statements, and business contexts. Almost always appears in the pattern ～が{急務|きゅうむ}だ (... is an urgent matter).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～が{急務|きゅうむ}だ: ... is an urgent task
- ～が{急務|きゅうむ}である: ... is a pressing matter (formal)
- ～が{急務|きゅうむ}とされている: ... is considered urgent
- {最|もっと}も{急務|きゅうむ}な{課題|かだい}: the most pressing issue

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喫緊|きっきん}の{急務|きゅうむ}: an extremely pressing matter
- {対策|たいさく}が{急務|きゅうむ}: countermeasures are urgently needed
- {改革|かいかく}が{急務|きゅうむ}: reform is urgently needed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {緊急|きんきゅう}: emergency, urgent — broader; can describe situations, not just tasks
- {喫緊|きっきん}: imminent urgency — even more formal; often paired with {急務|きゅうむ}
